name: Kazakhstan
famous_for: World's largest landlocked country, Baikonur Cosmodrome (space launch pad), Charyn Canyon, and nomadic horseback heritage.
tourists: Over 8.5M visitors; famous for Lake Kaindy sunken forest, Medeu high-altitude ice rink, and modern Astana architecture.
must_know: The dombra is a sacred two-stringed lute central to Kazakh musical storytelling; every household cherishes one.
fun_fact: Kazakhstan's Baikonur Cosmodrome was the launch site for both Sputnik 1 and Yuri Gagarin, the first human in space.
